links.outcome: Run-to-run repeatability of LLM outputs across repeated runs (percent agreement, Cohen's kappa)
links.effect: DeepSeek R1 showed repeatability of 3.41 ± 0.06 with stable schema compliance and run-to-run consistency; GPT-4o showed superior objective repeatability versus the other models.
links.quote: DeepSeek R1 showed competitive performance in structured reporting (4.0 ± 0.5) and repeatability (3.41 ± 0.06), with stable schema compliance and run-to-run consistency.

links.outcome: Comparison of three candidate LLMs on the same reports for extraction, impression, recommendation
links.effect: GPT-4o had the best diagnostic F1 (0.79 vs 0.54 DeepSeek R1 and 0.45 Gemini 2.5 Flash), highest balanced accuracy and MCC; Gemini 2.5 Flash consistently underperformed.
links.quote: GPT-4o consistently outperformed DeepSeek R1 and Gemini 2.5 Flash, supporting its potential to improve knee ultrasound report consistency and clinical utility.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of three LLMs (DeepSeek R1, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-4o) using physician ratings and benchmark metrics for structuring knee ultrasound reports without testing a deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
